AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: This app manages a high-fidelity AI Music Studio, user libraries, and content discovery. Operational Patterns: - Use 'strikeVibe' to initiate music generation with natural language. - Use 'warpMusic' to adjust tempo and density of the current session. - Use 'narratePOV' to trigger real-time AI narration of your surroundings. - Use 'searchForContent' to discover tracks and podcasts by keyword. - Use 'openLibrary' and 'openHome' to navigate between major app sections.
